description:
Use this when you need where the Sun, Moon and planets are at a moment (sidereal or tropical), not a reading.
Sun, Moon, planets and lunar nodes at one moment: longitude, latitude, distance, speed and retrograde flag, with sign, and nakṣatra and its quarter when sidereal. `equatorial: true` adds apparent right ascension and declination.
Cost: 0.1 credit per call, billed as 1 credit per started block of 10 Ephemeris calls (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"datetime":"2026-10-06T06:00:00Z","bodies":["Sun","Moon","Mars","Jupiter","Saturn","TrueNode"],"zodiac":"sidereal","ayanamsa":"lahiri"}

items.description: MeanNode and TrueNode are Rāhu (mean or true); Ketu is the node + 180°. Every AstroNest chart, reading and timing endpoint uses the mean node.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 with Z or an explicit offset, between 1800-01-02 and 2149-12-31 UTC. A time without a zone is refused (invalid_datetime).

equatorial.description: Also return apparent right ascension and declination. Default false.

name: get_ephemeris_positions

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

EphemerisBody.description: MeanNode and TrueNode are Rāhu (mean or true); Ketu is the node + 180°. Every AstroNest chart, reading and timing endpoint uses the mean node.

rightAscension.description: With equatorial: true. Apparent, of date, degrees.

speed.description: Degrees per day in longitude; negative = retrograde.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.

ayanamsaValue.description: Degrees; mean ayanamsa at the moment (sidereal only).

title: Positions at a moment
